meta.title: MTool text translation
meta.description: Translates an MTool game-text export with this profile's model and writes a JSON file MTool can load back. Usage: in MTool open 翻译 → 导出游戏原文 so a ManualTransFile.json appears next to the game, drop that file into the chat, and the agent calls translate_mtool_file; then pick the produced *.translated.json in MTool under 翻译 → 加载翻译文件. RPG Maker control codes such as \C[3], \V[1] and \n are masked, checked, and restored, and lines already translated are skipped, so a second run only pays for new text. Every call sends the pending game text to the model route configured in Settings and spends that route's tokens; large files are sent in batches of about 30 lines. A cache file named .mtool-translate-cache.json is written beside the export and can be deleted at any time. Turning the plugin off removes the tool and leaves the exported file untouched.
